answer: Make each agent keep its own story straight. At random, the network quizzes an identity about specifics of its past work: which vine pest it diagnosed in a client's garden, or why it once flagged a raven photo as mislabeled. A real agent keeps that history cheaply; a farm running thousands of personas must store and recall every one's record, and slips get payouts held. Continuity costs scale per identity, so sybils stop paying.
